digest.component_or_area: legacy-store migration, projects mapping ensure units
propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project field on tickets, causing sync to break on upgrade without migration
Migration must seed the projects mapping once with legacy_default and a single projects entry from Backend.project without writing per-ticket events
Two ensure units (seed-mapping and converge-capability-stamp) must be idempotent check-then-act and commit zero changes when converged
The capability stamp multi-project-bridge is conditional: single-project stores remain unstamped, multi-project stores gain the token in required_capabilities
A two-project stamped store must pass check_store_compat on the current binary and resolve every absent-bridge_project ticket to legacy_default
